name: Self-Consistency Improves Chain of Thought Reasoning in Language Models (arXiv:2203.11171)
notes: arXiv:2203.11171. Self-Consistency Improves Chain of Thought Reasoning in Language Models. By Xuezhi Wang et al. (Google). Submitted 2022-03-21. Improves chain-of-thought reasoning by sampling multiple reasoning paths and taking the majority answer.
